title: EmpUserProvisioningProcess - Data API
description: Represents an employee-user provisioning process. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

EndTime.description: The date and time that the user provisioning process ended.

ErrorRecordCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ErrorRecordCount.description: The number of records that encountered an error during the user provisioning process.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date and time when the user provisioning process was last referenced, with a precision of one second.

LastViewedDate.description: The date and time when the user provisioning process was last viewed, with a precision of one second.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the user provisioning process.

ProcessStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ProcessStatus.description: The status of the user provisioning process. Possible values are: Aborted Cancelled Failed Finished Initializing Processing Queued

StartTime.description: The date and time that the user provisioning process started.

SuccessRecordCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SuccessRecordCount.description: The number of records that were successfully provisioned during the user provisioning process.

TotalRecordCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TotalRecordCount.description: The total number of records in the user provisioning process.

special_access_rules: This object requires a Workplace Command Center add-on license, or an Employee Experience add-on license.
usage: Use the EmpUserProvisioningProcess to view the status of an employee-user provisioning process.
